result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a system/gesture-style bar overlaps the bottom navigation controls.

issues.description: A thick horizontal dark bar is rendered across the bottom navigation area, overlapping and partially obscuring the Search and Saved/Bookmark icons.
issues.suggestion: Place the gesture/home indicator outside the app navigation content using appropriate safe-area insets, or add bottom padding so the navigation icons remain fully visible and tappable.
